prompts: Why does plate material change the sound?
Is a 65% layout good for gaming?
What does lubing stabilizers actually do?
meta.measures: Per run, the same compose request via responses.parse (non-streaming total = time to first text today) and responses.stream (first delta, first visible answer text, total). OpenAI timings start at the compose call; factsMs is reported separately.
meta.doesNotShow: That the product meets CP1 §3.2.4. The product does not stream; this shows whether streaming would bring first answer text under 2,000 ms on this machine.
meta.environmentCaveat: Latency is dominated by network round-trip and provider queueing. These figures characterise THIS machine and network only.
